title: Stochastic Perturbation of Sweeping Processes Driven by Continuous Uniformly Prox-Regular Moving Sets
summary: In this paper, we study the existence of solutions to sweeping processes in the presence of stochastic perturbations, where the moving set takes uniformly prox-regular values and varies continuously with respect to the Hausdorff distance, without smoothness assumptions. We propose a minimal geometric framework for such moving sets, make precise the logical implications between several standard hypotheses in the literature, and provide practical sufficient conditions that apply in particular to constraints defined as finite intersections of sublevel sets.
